_comment: Advisories the NPM Security Audit gate waives (scripts/npm-audit-gate.mjs). Each entry needs a reason and a review_by date; an expired entry fails the gate again. Keep this list to advisories with no usable fix.

advisories.reason: No patched braces release exists (checked 2026-10-09). It enters through tailwindcss's build-time file tooling (chokidar, micromatch, fast-glob); the UI never expands untrusted brace patterns.
Fixed only in 7.x, while tailwindcss 3.4 and postcss-nested pin 6.x (checked 2026-10-09). It parses first-party CSS at build time.
